//: buildCommand deliberately does NOT run `prisma migrate deploy`.
A build runs on every push, including every preview deployment, and a
preview inherits whatever DATABASE_URL its environment supplies. Migrating
from the build step would mean an in-flight branch could alter a schema that
production is serving. Migrations are a deliberate, separately-credentialed
step — see docs/VERCEL-DEPLOYMENT.md. The runtime role (tinycrm_app) has no
DDL grant, so this would fail anyway; not relying on that is the point.
`prisma generate` is required: the client is generated into src/generated
and is gitignored, so it does not exist in a fresh checkout.

crons.//: The job runner. Replaces `npm run worker`, which cannot exist here.
Retention sweep: expired sessions, spent tokens, completed events.
